searches.reason: Test whether recommendations actually use recent intent and repeated narrow preferences. Seek practical probes that mask recent versus older interactions, shuffle sequence order, and remove repeated-item evidence; measure resulting rank changes against matched random perturbations. These interventions can reveal whether sequence modeling contributes beyond popularity and broad associations, without treating sensitivity as proof of correctness.
searches.query: sequential recommendation temporal counterfactual diagnostics history ablation recency preference drift popularity controlled rank sensitivity SASRec 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Develop an evidence-based audit of full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the twenty training users. Use only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions to distinguish supported complements, possible substitutes for recently purchased items, explicit compatibility conflicts, and insufficient evidence. Seek annotation protocols with an unknown category and agreement checks, so missing equipment information never becomes an invented mismatch or user preference.
searches.query: recommendation explanation evaluation evidence grounded compatibility complementary substitute products purchase intent uncertainty abstention annotation protocol item titles descriptions 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Make diagnostics trustworthy and actionable by testing whether they distinguish known injected failures and predict changes in the pinned validation HR@10. Seek inexpensive controls for ignored sequence order, popularity-dominated scores, and representation collapse; compare pairwise margins with ranking probes, report uncertainty by dataset, and connect each detected failure to a specific model component or training intervention. Reserve validation users from diagnostic fitting and retain the host evaluation unchanged.
searches.query: recommender system diagnostic probe validation fault injection negative controls sampled versus full catalog ranking effective rank representation collapse bootstrap uncertainty 2024 2025 2026
